annotator: The ECB+ authors annotated the corpus. Round #3130 took the event of a document from its topic and its sub-corpus (ecb or ecbplus): the seminal event of the subtopic.
boundaryRule: All documents of one topic and one sub-corpus (ecb or ecbplus) report one event. Each such subtopic was written about one seminal event.

source.name: ECB+ (Event Coreference Bank Plus)
source.licence: The ECB+ annotation is licensed CC BY 3.0 (ECB+_LREC2014/LICENSEDATA.TXT and COPYING-CC.TXT). The news texts belong to their publishers and are not in this repository.
source.attribution: Agata Cybulska and Piek Vossen. 2014. Using a sledgehammer to crack a nut? Lexical diversity and event coreference resolution. In Proceedings of LREC 2014. ECB+ annotation copyright Agata Cybulska, Piek Vossen and the VU University of Amsterdam.

weaknesses: The label is the subtopic, not the event of each document. A document that also reports another event keeps the subtopic label.
ECB+ gives no dates. The runner gives every document one publish day, so one clustering of the window groups the whole set.
The rows have no titles. The detector takes the first real sentence as the title.
